question: Under unchanged current-main acquisition, draw, energy and play-order policy, does each identity-safe fight-local v2 block naturally reach its producer, consumer and payoff often enough to justify a separate common-random-number causal panel?

identityGate.authority: Capacity screen only; no endpoint or candidate claim.

scoreline.whyThisLevel: The current Faultline conditional bonus is the predeclared central authored anchor. Every positive Scoreline token has the same activation path; this screen estimates activation, not magnitude.

afterimage.whyThisLevel: The current Ward card base gain is the predeclared producer anchor. Every positive Afterimage token has the same activation path; this screen estimates activation, not magnitude.

factorDefinitions.factorSeparation: Scoreline and Afterimage remain independent. The opposite research factor is fixed off, but all opposite cards, acquisition pools, policy rules and authored effects remain present and unchanged in every arm.
factorDefinitions.jointDisposition: No joint arm. The exact v2 direct joint anchor reproduced both single-factor event streams and values with zero interference, so a whole-run joint capacity row has no measured decision value.

design.type: three-arm mechanism-blocked natural-exposure capacity census with common random numbers; not an endpoint causal panel
design.sharedAnchors: Every arm uses the same root-553 policy index, simulation seed, Duskblade Vow-5 baseline, content, acquisition and combat policy, estimator and stopping rule.
design.policy: Exact current-main policy grammar. No timing, hold, acquisition, rarity, random-play or random-build control is added.
design.telemetry: Direct producer, mediator-set, consumer, mediator-consume, payoff requested/realised and expiry counters from the identity-safe v2 representation.
design.aliasStructure: The off arm is the shared current-main null. Each enabled arm changes one categorical research factor only. Capacity counts do not estimate payoff magnitude or endpoints, and no row is selected out after execution.
design.reliability: All off rows remain in the census. Any enabled stall or error not present in its exact off identity is an automatic block failure.

cohort.disjointness: Root 553 and both seeds are absent from v1 and v2 identity designs and from protected acceptance/reserve ranges.

estimands.activeRow: An enabled row with at least one exact payoff event for that block.
estimands.robustActivePolicy: A fixed root-553 policy identity with at least one exact payoff event in both frozen simulation seeds.
estimands.progression: Total producer, consumer and payoff event counts, with producer=mediator-set and consumer=mediator-consume=payoff in every row.
estimands.valueIntegrity: Every Scoreline requested total equals six times payoff count and realised damage lies in [0, requested]. Every Afterimage stored/requested value lies in [0, five per event], producer realised Ward covers stored Ward, and mirrored realised Ward equals requested Ward.
estimands.factorIsolation: The opposite block emits zero events in every enabled row.
estimands.policyIdentity: Exact policy snapshot equality for off versus each enabled arm at every shared identity.
estimands.reliability: Zero candidate-added stall or error rows.
estimands.notEstimated: Win rate, loss, HP, duration, economy, reward effect, causal endpoint, complementarity, candidate feasibility, detector acceptance, product balance and protected-seed confirmation.

supportFloor.rationale: Eight is one eighth of the fixed 64-policy repertoire and forces at least 16 independent policy-seed payoff observations before spending a larger CRN panel. It is a preregistered decision-value floor, not a significance threshold.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python constructs all three complete arm rectangles before execution, runs one Godot process, content-addresses plan and output, computes exact capacity gates and appends all 384 observations to the one ledger in one transaction.
order: Verify v2 identity success, task capsule, repository refs, source hashes, Godot and ledger freeze.
Evaluate telemetry integrity, factor isolation, policy identity, reliability and support for each block independently.
Atomically append the complete observation set, verify sequence growth, zero protected rows and SQLite integrity, then emit the automatic disposition.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The complete 384-row design is the only look. No arm, policy, seed, threshold or token changes after execution.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: This stage may admit a block to whole-run causal evaluation but cannot support an endpoint claim itself.

decisionRules.blockSuccess: The block has at least eight robust active policies, 16 active rows and 16 payoff events; all telemetry, factor-isolation and policy gates pass; and it adds no stall or error.
decisionRules.blockSuccessAuthority: Admit that block only to one separately preregistered smallest sufficient CRN causal panel. Do not choose a payoff level or candidate from capacity counts.
decisionRules.blockFutility: Any telemetry, isolation, policy or reliability fault occurs, or any of the three support floors is missed at the complete cap.
decisionRules.blockFutilityAuthority: Close that exact block and continue inside #421 with the next evidence-backed minimal mechanism for the missing package; do not add a timing/hold control unless the observed decomposition specifically identifies policy order as the bottleneck.
decisionRules.bothSuccess: Admit both blocks to separate CRN panels; do not add a joint cell.
decisionRules.mixed: Admit the one successful block and close the other at capacity; continue autonomously for the missing second package.
decisionRules.bothFutility: Close fight-local v2 at capacity and continue with the next evidence-backed mechanism class.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The frozen input, output or atomic ledger receipt is unavailable, or the complete decision exceeds 120 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record at cap. Do not rerun, change cohort, repair, infer an endpoint or use protected seeds.
